chunks: Then, if he is one of the honoured,

key_terms.الْمُقَرَّبِينَ: The Probitated / The Honoured (a high rank of closeness to God)

ai.seo_question: What does it mean to be among the Muqarrabun in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'al-Muqarrabun' represent the highest tier of the righteous, distinguished by their unwavering devotion and proximity to the Divine, often associated with the Ahl al-Bayt and the Imams. This conditional clause highlights the ultimate reward for those who perfect their spiritual station through faith and righteous deeds, surpassing even the general rank of the 'Sabequn' (forerunners).
